name: bar-mods
description: Claude Code mods by Bar Moshe: live panes, bands and a workbench for building mods, all running inside Claude Code.

plugins.name: turn-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt: the tool running now during a turn, and a one-line summary of the last turn after it.

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: A live pane: context ring, session cost, a colored timeline of every tool call, files edited, and a sports-commentator recap of each turn.

plugins.name: modsmith
plugins.description: A workbench for building Claude Code mods: which mods loaded, a live tape of every event with its real payload, the four ship gates on the mod in progress, and tools so Claude can read payloads and run the gates itself.

plugins.name: surface-probe
plugins.description: A pane to open before designing for a surface: its width and placement, right-to-left text, SVG, and whether a button can send Claude a message.

plugins.name: rtl-kit
plugins.description: Right-to-left for mods: one file to copy into a mod so Hebrew and Arabic read right, wrap right-aligned, and draw as cards, tabs, tables, markdown and SVG timelines, in the terminal too.

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: Where a plan stands, beside the conversation: a band above the prompt and a pane drawn from a plain Markdown block, and a tool so Claude keeps it current one line at a time.
